# Atomic governed change

An admitted change publishes its definitions, exact source captures, selected revisions and original operation receipt together. The trusted host supplies current authority. This explanation is derived from ontology section 21.4; project acceptance is separate.

# Atomic governed change

The library checks current authority and exact expected revisions before publishing the complete typed graph, original artifacts, selected baseline and original operation receipt. An uncertain caller resolves that original operation after recovery. This revised explanation is authored for this walkthrough; it does not change historical test outcomes or record human acceptance.
